facts.fact: DataXion, a multi-operator colocation datacentre in Tunis owned by Poulina Group Holding, was inaugurated in May 2016 and offers IT housing to businesses (1,200 m2 over four rooms of 400 kW each).

DataXion states it is the only Tier IV-certified datacentre in Tunisia (operator's own claim; the certifying body is not named on the page); as_of is the page's published date as it gives no certification date.
